items.title: While Bitcoin Devs Debate Next Moves, IonQ Unveils Superion 256 Quantum Computer
items.summary: The company has built its first chips and begun testing prototypes as it seeks to manufacture quantum computers in larger quantities.

items.title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as Bessent fuels yen strength around 153 per dollar
items.summary: Bitcoin trended lower with US stocks on Iran escalation while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent contributed to fears of a yen carry-trade unwind.

items.title: Arbitrum Watchdog Seeks Permanent Bans For Three Grant Recipients
items.summary: The committee behind Arbitrum's grant-misuse bounty program wants Good Entry, Limitless and APX Finance barred from all future DAO programs.

items.title: Hyperliquid Policy Center backs CFTC in fight over perpetual futures, asks court to drop CME’s case
items.summary: The Hyperliquid Policy Center accused CME Group of stifling innovation and urged a court to dismiss the exchange’s lawsuit against the CFTC.
